playlist._about: Deep Connections in piano arrangements, without the original intro. Played by the Vienna Piano Stage page (its song slot), started only by PLAY. Tracks without a delivered piano master cannot be played; the original recording is never used.

segments.title: PRE-SHOW
segments.director: Runbook cue 00. Confirm audio, piano scene, mic, camera, chat and playlist. Mic muted. The Vienna Piano Stage page must show CONNECTED (OBS) in Show Control → Playlist.

segments.title: OPENING VIDEO — PIANO SESSIONS
segments.director: STEP 1 · PLAY OPENING VIDEO. GO plays the Piano Sessions opening film (V35, its own sound) full screen in OPENING. Host mic muted. Nothing else starts. The film has NOT been delivered yet: until it is, GO reports VIDEO NOT AVAILABLE and nothing plays — then run the stage's official short opening by hand (Show Control → Playlist → Piano Stage: Opening; 44 s + DISTANCE // ZERO Piano Version) or go straight on. When the film has ended: GO → HOST WELCOME.

segments.title: HOST WELCOME
segments.script: ANDY'K: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to DISTANCE // ZERO Piano Sessions. I'm DJ Andy'K, joining you live from Vienna. You've just heard the piano interpretation of our DISTANCE // ZERO theme — a piece about bringing distant worlds closer through music.
segments.director: STEP 2 · HOST WELCOME. GO puts your own camera full screen (HOST · PIANO): you at your piano. Open the mic with TALK. No song starts here — the playlist plays only on PLAY. After the welcome: TALK off, then GO → CINEMATIC TRANSITION.

segments.title: CINEMATIC STUDIO TRANSITION
segments.director: STEP 3 · START CINEMATIC TRANSITION. GO cuts to the stage picture (PIANO STAGE · CLEAN, no host camera) and starts the stage's camera flight: the whole studio — architecture, lights, the piano, the big monitors — then back to the main monitor, which shows the Piano Stage, closer and closer until its picture fills the frame. No black, no jump. Mic closed. Needs the stage's cinematic transition from the Virtual Space (PIANO-OPENING-HANDOFF.md): until the stage has it, GO says so and the stage picture stays. When the picture is the Piano Stage: GO → PIANO PERFORMANCE.

segments.title: PIANO PERFORMANCE — LIVE STAGE
segments.director: STEP 4 · ENTER PIANO PERFORMANCE. GO switches to PIANO STAGE: the piano stays big, your camera appears small at the bottom. The stage goes to LIVE PIANO (its own sound stops). During a song the stage's cameras P1–P5 and lights follow the music. No song starts by itself: PLAY in the Playlist when you are ready. Then GO → ALBUM INTRODUCTION.

segments.title: ALBUM INTRODUCTION
segments.script:
ANDY'K: Tonight I'd like to take you back to Deep Connections, an album I released in 2026. Its original sound belongs to house and progressive house. But tonight, we're listening differently. No drops, no heavy beats — just the piano, the melodies and the stories behind the music.
ANDY'K: The idea behind Deep Connections was simple: every track can be a bridge between two worlds. Tonight, I hope these piano versions create a bridge between us, too. And yes — the chat is open. I'll be reading your messages between songs.
segments.talkingPoints: Official concept: "Connection is the core. Every track a bridge between two worlds."

segments.title: ALBUM PERFORMANCES — DEEP CONNECTIONS (PIANO)
segments.script:
ANDY'K: Sometimes a title is all it takes to open a question. For this next piece, I'd like you to listen without trying to decide what the music means right away. Let the piano tell its own story. [01 GAME]
ANDY'K: Some melodies feel close to us before we can explain why. Here is In My Veins, reimagined for piano. I hope you hear something in it that feels personal to you. [02 IN MY VEINS]
ANDY'K: Music can bring back a feeling in an instant — much like a familiar scent. This is Perfume, heard tonight in a quieter form. [03 PERFUME]
ANDY'K: There is a certain stillness that comes with the late hours, even when the world keeps moving. This is my piano interpretation of Midnight Drive. [04 MIDNIGHT DRIVE]
ANDY'K: Sometimes the softest music leaves the most room for reflection. Our next piece is called Mask. I'll let the piano speak first. [05 MASK]
ANDY'K: For this next song, I want to leave you with the music rather than an explanation. This is Stone, in its piano version. [06 STONE]
segments.talkingPoints:
Song Information (official album page text) — Show Control → Playlist shows it next to each track.
01 GAME — Someone who always holds the winning hand — and you play anyway, because losing to them still feels like winning.
02 IN MY VEINS — A love that poisons as much as it heals — a spell you can feel taking you under, and still don't want to break.
03 PERFUME — The scent that outlasts the person — invisible, impossible to wash off, a memory living on skin long after they're gone.
04 MIDNIGHT DRIVE — The hour the city empties out — just the two of you, the open road, and no reason left to turn back.
05 MASK — The face we show the world — polished, fragile, never built to last, because the mirror always tells the truth it was hiding.
06 STONE — What's left standing after the noise fades — heavy with every secret, unmoved by time, still holding the truth.
segments.director: Runbook cue 05. Each track: say its intro (mic on, TALK), then TALK off and PLAY in Show Control → Playlist. Host mic off during the performance. The next track starts only when you press PLAY (or NEXT). Optional: Between songs ident on the stage. Deep Connection (Intro) is not performed.

segments.title: AUDIENCE MOMENT
segments.script:
ANDY'K: I can see your messages coming in — thank you for being here. I'm curious: what changes for you when you hear a song played only on piano?
ANDY'K: If you know the original Deep Connections album, you can find it on my official website and on streaming platforms. Tonight, though, we're keeping this room entirely for the piano.
segments.talkingPoints: Read selected live questions. Chat is optional between songs; no mandatory interruption.
segments.director: Runbook cue 06. Viewer chat: Show Control (top). Do not start the next track automatically.

segments.title: CLOSING REMARKS
segments.script:
ANDY'K: Thank you for sharing this first Piano Session with me. Deep Connections began in a completely different musical world, and tonight we heard what those melodies can become when the piano takes the lead.
ANDY'K: If you'd like to discover the original versions, visit djandykofficial.com/deep-connections or find the album on your favourite streaming platform. Tell me which piano interpretation stayed with you tonight — and what you'd like to hear next.
ANDY'K: From Vienna, this is DJ Andy'K. Two worlds. One room. Music connects us. Good night.

segments.title: CLOSING
segments.director: Runbook cue 08. Mic off (TALK off) before GO. GO plays the stage's official closing ident (38 s): slow shots, the light comes down, SHOW ENDED. The approved closing FILM has not been delivered: when it is, put it on this cue (Video Player in CLOSING). End the stream after SHOW ENDED.
